alarm.title: Time's Up
alarm.hint: Press "End Exam" to stop the alarm
hint.usage_lines: Enter either 'Start + End time' or 'Start + Duration'
Alarm sounds automatically at zero; press 'End Exam' to stop
Countdown turns yellow in the last 5 minutes
Time stays accurate even if you switch tabs or your system sleeps
Uses Web Audio for the alarm — works even when system is muted
Notice can be edited any time during the exam
Four windows during the exam can be dragged and resized; press ⟳ (top-right) to reset
